newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs seen having positive bias.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs seen having positive bias.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: injection of 100 bln yen -------------VIEWS FROM THE MARKET - July 2 ------------------

*JGBs likely to have positive bias in expectation of accomodative Bank of Japan credit stance to fend off upward pressure on rates at longer end of money market. *Key 3-month CD issued at 0.70 percent, highest since August 7. *Part of the 400 billion yen of 1.9 percent six-year JGBs offered by Finance Ministry on Tuesday left unsold in the market.
